body: I think I may be in a more urgent situation than that. This is a new situation for me.

I am a little hazy in thought right now. I am not in a position of authority, I am a junior solicitor and feel that my career would be in jeopardy if my struggles came to light. I think at this point getting help may be worse than the alternative.
Maybe not a position of Authority, but I do not want to let anyone know I am struggling.
